mappedContracts.statement: Publish or submit the mature server to npm, the official MCP Registry, Glama, Smithery, and mcp.so, and verify downstream indexing by PulseMCP and MCP Atlas.
acceptanceCriteria: Use account-gated submissions when credentials and permissions are available.
When an external gate remains, implement every local artefact and script, create a precise owner action with submission data, and keep the track open.
Interpret the user's 'glamira' reference as Glama unless a distinct service is identified during refreshed research.
requiredEvidence: Verified listing URLs or external-gate receipts

mappedContracts.statement: Submit or verify discovery in other relevant MCP ecosystems, including Cline Marketplace, VS Code MCP Gallery via the official registry, Docker MCP Catalog, awesome-mcp-servers, Cursor Directory, Claude extensions if eligible, and maintained community directories.
acceptanceCriteria: Eligibility and submission requirements are refreshed at execution time.
Low-quality or abandoned directories are not pursued merely to inflate counts.
Each listing is monitored for build, security, and metadata drift.
